description: This source file contains platform-specific shell functions for upgrading firmware images, including device-specific upgrade procedures, image validation, and configuration copying logic.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the existing firmware image for specific partition conditions and prompts for partition removal if needed.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for Askey devices by extracting and flashing the root filesystem from the provided firmware archive.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs Zyxel-specific upgrade, extracting kernel and root filesystem to appropriate partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs Mikrotik device upgrade using NAND flash, formatting the kernel partition and flashing the kernel and root.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main dispatch function to determine and execute the appropriate upgrade procedure based on device type.
